3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I arrived at the Grand National Assembly, which was only a five-minute drive away from the Palace.

4.speaker: Gloria Tory
4.text: "Good to see you here, Mr. Rayne."

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Today, I had a private meeting with Gloria Tory, one of the leading figures of the USP, to get her approval for the proposal. She was also key in reaching 150 signatures to propose the new Constitution, as she had extensive control over our party's conservative and moderate wings.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: As I walked through the corridors of the Grand National Assembly, I was confronted by my memories of the historic building. Despite being a member of Assembly not long ago, it now felt like the distant past.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I walked into the left wing of the Assembly which currently acted as the quarters of the USP. Gloria's office was the first one inside.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I knocked on the door and entered.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: It was a small, neatly organised office. There were small figurines, photos and plants around the place. It had a homey feel, unlike my own Assembly office when I had worked there.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: On her gesture, I took a seat. The chair was very uncomfortable.

12.speaker: Gloria Tory
12.text: "We both know why we are here. You want me to give you my support."
12.conditionsRaw:
(((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == false  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == false)  and  
Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_Default"] == false  or  
Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Default"] == false)

13.speaker: Player
13.text: "I love what you did with the office."

15.speaker: Gloria Tory
15.text: "I'm fine, Mr. Rayne. How are you?"

16.speaker: Gloria Tory
16.text: "*A woman's touch* they call it. Like men cannot have a sense of tidiness or style."

17.speaker: Gloria Tory
17.text: "Anyway, let's keep this simple, Mr. Rayne."

20.speaker: Player
20.text: "I'm very happy to see you, Mrs. Tory. It's been a while."

26.speaker: Player
26.text: "The chair is fine, but the work that comes with it is insane."

27.speaker: Gloria Tory
27.text: "Well, you knew about that, didn't you?"

28.speaker: Gloria Tory
28.text: "I'm sure it doesn't give you back pains the way ours do."

29.speaker: Gloria Tory
29.text: "I don't see why the backbone of the USP would support your rushed reforms. Don't you realize they go directly against the wishes of the founder of this party and the state?"

30.speaker: Player
30.text: "The reforms are not against anyone. It's all in the name of democracy."

31.speaker: Player
31.text: "Mrs. Tory, I need you to help me here."

32.speaker: Player
32.text: "My reforms are very critical for the future of Sordland, Mrs. Tory."

34.speaker: Gloria Tory
34.text: "You'd like the USP to disintegrate, wouldn't you, Mr. Rayne?"

35.speaker: Gloria Tory
35.text: "Even though you owe everything to Colonel Soll, I think you never liked him, nor the party he built."

36.speaker: Gloria Tory
36.text: "So you want me to help you destroy what our party has worked so hard to build?"

37.speaker: Gloria Tory
37.text: "They are certainly critical for destroying what our party has worked so hard to build."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "There is nothing personal about this, Mrs. Tory."

40.speaker: Player
40.text: "How dare you suggest I never liked Soll? I'm a proud Sollist."

41.speaker: Gloria Tory
41.text: "You claim that, Mr. Rayne, but the Sollists already know who you are working with."

42.speaker: Gloria Tory
42.text: "Whatever you intend to do, you will be facing quite the opposition."

44.speaker: Player
44.text: "I'm sure we can make a deal."

48.speaker: Player
48.text: "Perhaps I could change your thoughts on the matter...with some well placed investments?"

49.speaker: Player
49.text: "You must understand that these reforms are a necessity. Let me explain."

51.speaker: Player
51.text: "We need these reforms to fix our problems with the unrestricted power of the Supreme Court."

52.speaker: Player
52.text: "The people of Sordland demanded change. The USP must give them what they want. We need the people's support."

53.speaker: Player
53.text: "The USP is a party that knows how to react in changing times. We must lead the nation into the future."

54.speaker: Gloria Tory
54.text: "The Supreme Court is already doing what it can to preserve Soll's values."

55.speaker: Gloria Tory
55.text: "You think you can bribe me, Mr. President?"

56.speaker: Gloria Tory
56.text: "For your safety, I hope that nobody heard that. The walls here are not as thick as in your palace."

61.speaker: Gloria Tory
61.text: "Especially when you're trying to decrease the electoral threshold."

62.speaker: Gloria Tory
62.text: "You must know this will mean bringing the communists into the Assembly. You probably have a deal with either them or... maybe the PFJP. Frens seemed to be positive about giving you support too."

66.speaker: Gloria Tory
66.text: "Especially considering the fact that you're trying to change the Member of Honor laws. This is clearly a move against President Soll."
66.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_NoImmunity"] == true)

69.speaker: Player
69.text: "The decrease is important to democratize our elections."

70.speaker: Player
70.text: "I can reconsider the decrease in the threshold."

71.speaker: Gloria Tory
71.text: "I don't know how your acts can even be justified inside the USP."

72.speaker: Gloria Tory
72.text: "There is no problem here except the ones you are creating with Mr. Ricter."

73.speaker: Gloria Tory
73.text: "I am aware that our popularity has been on the decline."

74.speaker: Gloria Tory
74.text: "But I blame it on this administration, Mr. Rayne. Plus, these reforms are not about the people, are they?"

75.speaker: Gloria Tory
75.text: "That's for the party to decide. Not you."

76.speaker: Gloria Tory
76.text: "I seriously do not know if the conservatives would be willing to support you at all."

78.speaker: Player
78.text: "Yes, I'll remove the change to the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

80.speaker: Gloria Tory
80.text: "I don't know what to say before seeing a commitment from you, Mr. Rayne."

82.speaker: Player
82.text: "First I need to know if I'll have your support."

83.speaker: Gloria Tory
83.text: "I don't know if I can promise anything before I see action from you. Especially with all these issues you're creating for the party."

84.speaker: Gloria Tory
84.text: "That's a step in the right direction."

85.speaker: Gloria Tory
85.text: "I'm sure it isn't. It must be about some other Member of Honor."

86.speaker: Player
86.text: "Very well. I'll remove the change to the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

93.speaker: Gloria Tory
93.text: "Decreasing the threshold to 3% is unacceptable. You will be bringing all of the marginal parties into the Assembly and reducing our majority."

94.speaker: Gloria Tory
94.text: "I do not support an election threshold of 8%. This sets a dangerous situation for us, as both the WPB and the CPS will gain more power."

95.speaker: Gloria Tory
95.text: "I cannot allow you to destroy our party. Either this point is removed entirely or there will be no discussion."

96.speaker: Gloria Tory
96.text: "I'd rather leave the threshold as it is."

97.speaker: Player
97.text: "That is not up to you, Mrs. Tory. My proposed threshold stays."

101.speaker: Gloria Tory
101.text: "All I can promise is that the conservatives will definitely oppose you unless you remove that clause."

102.speaker: Player
102.text: "Fine, I'll remove the change to the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

110.speaker: Gloria Tory
110.text: "That's too bad. Yet you still want our support..."

112.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

119.speaker: Gloria Tory
119.text: "I don't see why the backbone of this party should support your rushed reforms."

120.speaker: Player
120.text: "These reforms are very critical for the future of Sordland, Mrs. Tory."

121.speaker: Player
121.text: "Mrs. Tory, I need you to help me here."

122.speaker: Player
122.text: "We need these reforms for our democracy."

127.speaker: Gloria Tory
127.text: "I don't know if I can be of any help."

129.speaker: Gloria Tory
129.text: "What you are doing seems more like a move against the Supreme Court."

139.speaker: Gloria Tory
139.text: "I do not support this proposal the way it currently stands. But you seem to be willing to talk, so let's talk."

143.speaker: Gloria Tory
143.text: "...But your changes to the Member of Honor laws are a major obstacle. We obviously can't condone any threats against Colonel Tarquin Soll."

144.speaker: Player
144.text: "This is a shame. I was hoping we could work together."

145.speaker: Gloria Tory
145.text: "You want to punish him for the aggressive policies he pursued in the past? Is that the intention here? You can't win this fight, Mr. President. Soll built this republic in the midst of blood and chaos. He demands respect."

146.speaker: Player
146.text: "I have no intention of putting Colonel Soll on trial."

148.speaker: Gloria Tory
148.text: "You should at least remove the changes to the Member of Honor laws, or there will be no further discussion."

152.speaker: Gloria Tory
152.text: "You can't just target our founder and expect our support. If this point is not removed, expect a grand opposition."

153.speaker: Player
153.text: "Why are you against all this, Mrs. Tory? I was thinking we could work together."

155.speaker: Player
155.text: "Fine. I'll remove the changes to the Member of Honor laws from the proposal." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

156.speaker: Gloria Tory
156.text: "I'm trying my best to work with you, Mr. President. Yet you're not listening to your own party members."

157.speaker: Gloria Tory
157.text: "So, you're not removing the clause from the proposal?"

158.speaker: Player
158.text: "Fine. I'll remove the changes to the Member of Honor laws from the proposal." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

159.speaker: Player
159.text: "No. We could talk about the other clauses instead."

165.speaker: Gloria Tory
165.text: "Great. Now, we can start talking for real."

179.speaker: Gloria Tory
179.text: "I must say that I wouldn't have given the Assembly the right to nominate ministers. This can create a lot of problems for future governments."
179.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_NoImmunity"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_ConfidenceVote"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Assembly"] == true)

180.speaker: Gloria Tory
180.text: "I must say that I like the changes regarding the appointment of ministers. That's one positive aspect."
180.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_NoImmunity"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_ConfidenceVote"] == true)

187.speaker: Gloria Tory
187.text: "I must say that I expected some sort of a reform regarding the appointment of ministers. I am surprised that you're ignoring the large support behind that."
187.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_8"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_NoImmunity"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_ConfidenceVote"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Assembly"] == true) == false)

188.speaker: Player
188.text: "What makes you think that I don't respect him?"

189.speaker: Gloria Tory
189.text: "Isn't it? You have promised to reform our government branches, yet your proposal points to another agenda."

190.speaker: Gloria Tory
190.text: "Then why are you taking away his title? Why strike against an old man who has fought all his life for our country?"

194.speaker: Gloria Tory
194.text: "Then why are you taking his immunity away? He isn't even a public figure since he retired from politics. What prompted you to include this in your so called 'democracy' package?"

195.speaker: Gloria Tory
195.text: "So was I, Mr. President. I remember when you proudly defended the USP's values. Yet it seems that it was just politics."

199.speaker: Gloria Tory
199.text: "Somehow I always knew it wasn't going to happen. I still remember how you backstabbed President Soll in favor of the incompetency of Alphonso."

200.speaker: Gloria Tory
200.text: "I expected that you would go this route already."

201.speaker: Gloria Tory
201.text: "Are you seriously asking me this, Mr. President? I thought we were talking about *your* proposal."

205.speaker: Gloria Tory
205.text: "Don't forget that I was there when you backstabbed President Soll in favour of the incompetency of Alphonso."

206.speaker: Player
206.text: "The Member of Honor laws are unnecessary and undemocratic. This is not about Soll."

207.speaker: Player
207.text: "How about you answer me this: Why did Soll grant himself absolute immunity and protection? What is he scared of?"

208.speaker: Player
208.text: "Let's calm down. I am here to listen to your concerns."

209.speaker: Player
209.text: "What are you talking about? There is no *agenda*."

210.speaker: Gloria Tory
210.text: "Anyway... I am not going to drag this out for any longer. Will you listen to the party or keep pushing your own agenda?"

212.speaker: Player
212.text: "Everything is politics, Mrs. Tory. You of all people must know this."

213.speaker: Player
213.text: "Let's calm down. I am here to listen to your concerns."

214.speaker: Gloria Tory
214.text: "Well, I've already stated my concerns, Mr. President. Let's listen to you."

217.speaker: Gloria Tory
217.text: "Soll is the only Member of Honor. This is automatically about him."

218.speaker: Gloria Tory
218.text: "Maybe it was a security mechanism against traitors like..."

220.speaker: Player
220.text: "Look, I promise that we won't touch him. But these ancient laws should be removed."

221.speaker: Player
221.text: "You win, Mrs. Tory. If this earns me your support, I will remove this point from the proposal." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

224.speaker: Player
224.text: "Come on, let's try to find some common ground."

225.speaker: Gloria Tory
225.text: "Fine. Let's talk about your other points."

227.speaker: Player
227.text: "Fine. I'll remove the changes to the Member of Honor laws from the proposal." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

233.speaker: Gloria Tory
233.text: "It is unbelievable that you are taking away the immunity of the Justices. A big mistake."

234.speaker: Gloria Tory
234.text: "Even though the Assembly is elected by the people, it does not hold enough judicial insight and neutrality to impeach Justices. The separation of powers shouldn't be damaged."

235.speaker: Gloria Tory
235.text: "It is also unbelievable that you are strengthening the already powerful presidential decrees. I don't know what your plans are, but I can easily say that I don't like it. This can go in a very bad direction."
235.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false)

236.speaker: Gloria Tory
236.text: "The fact that you are removing the possibility of your impeachment is not right. Giving yourself absolute immunity while in office is too bold."
236.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false)

243.speaker: Gloria Tory
243.text: "I don't see anything *democratic* here, Mr. President. Can you?"
243.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false)

244.speaker: Gloria Tory
244.text: "Not to mention that you are removing presidential decrees. I don't know who pressured you into that, but clearly that person has more influence on you than anyone else."

245.speaker: Gloria Tory
245.text: "On top of all that, you are removing the possibility of your own impeachment. Giving yourself absolute immunity while in office. That's bold."

246.speaker: Player
246.text: "It seems our understanding of democracy is very different."

248.speaker: Player
248.text: "What I see is a bright future for Sordland. We need to be united."

249.speaker: Player
249.text: "Let's change the topic and discuss how I can make you and the conservatives happy."

253.speaker: Gloria Tory
253.text: "Who are you kidding? This proposal is designed for your own benefit."

256.speaker: Gloria Tory
256.text: "By listening to our concerns and acting on them? I represent the conservative wing of the party, Mr. President. You should realize that you're not interacting with just one person here."

257.speaker: Gloria Tory
257.text: "So what are you thinking about? Are you ready to make changes to your proposal or should we keep talking past each other?"

258.speaker: Player
258.text: "Mrs. Tory, please try to understand me. I cannot give concessions now."

268.speaker: Player
268.text: "I will remove the changes about the impeachment of the presidents." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

269.speaker: Player
269.text: "You're right. I will not strengthen presidential decrees. Let's keep it as it is." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

270.speaker: Player
270.text: "Fine. We will not touch the immunity of the Justices. Let's remove that point." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

271.speaker: Gloria Tory
271.text: "That is certainly a step in the right direction..."

272.speaker: Gloria Tory
272.text: "Finally. The proposal is starting to make some sense."

273.speaker: Gloria Tory
273.text: "Finally. The proposal is starting to make some sense."

278.speaker: Gloria Tory
278.text: "Let me give you some advice, Mr. President. Giving yourself the same title as Tarquin Soll will not make you a hero. You have not earned that title nor the immunity and the protection it brings."
278.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false)

279.speaker: Gloria Tory
279.text: "Remove the changes to the Member of Honor laws from the proposal before it becomes public. Let's not damage our party nor your reputation further. This will only bring you ridicule."

280.speaker: Gloria Tory
280.text: "And there is no way that the Assembly or the Supreme Court would vote for this."

281.speaker: Gloria Tory
281.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Impeachment_Default"] == false)  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false)) == false)

282.speaker: Narrator
282.text: She raised an eyebrow and then took a look at the proposal on her table.

283.speaker: Narrator
283.text: She took a long look at the proposal on her table.

284.speaker: Gloria Tory
284.text: "You are a stubborn man. But anyway..."

285.speaker: Player
285.text: "You are right. That is one risky topic. I will remove it." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

286.speaker: Player
286.text: "You can believe what you will, Mrs. Tory. Just tell me if you will give us support or not."

287.speaker: Player
287.text: "You might be right but that will not stop me from trying. I wish you'd join me in this endeavour."

288.speaker: Gloria Tory
288.text: "I'm glad we are on the same page."

294.speaker: Gloria Tory
294.text: "All right, Mr. President. I'm sorry I won't be able to help you. I wish you luck gathering the signatures you need."

299.speaker: Gloria Tory
299.text: "There is one other way for you to gain my support."

300.speaker: Gloria Tory
300.text: "Put my name at the top of the list of Supreme Court Justice candidates. In case of a vacancy in the Supreme Court, I want to be appointed."

301.speaker: Player
301.text: "If that's going to assure your support, you have my word."

302.speaker: Player
302.text: "That's it? That's easy. Consider it done."

303.speaker: Player
303.text: "That's a deal, Mrs. Tory. I'll expect your votes in return."

310.speaker: Gloria Tory
310.text: "I reviewed your proposal in detail. It's a fine draft. Your changes aren't major enough to cause any difficulties."

311.speaker: Gloria Tory
311.text: "I can get you the signatures needed for the proposal. I'll talk to the other conservatives."

312.speaker: Gloria Tory
312.text: "I hope there won't be any surprises though, Mr. President."

315.speaker: Player
315.text: "Your lack of faith in me is disappointing."

316.speaker: Player
316.text: "I assure you, there is nothing you should be concerned about."

324.speaker: Gloria Tory
324.text: "We have to calculate every possibility, Mr. President. After all, I do not see eye to eye with your other policies."

325.speaker: Gloria Tory
325.text: "Especially the continuation of Alphonso's free market reforms..."

326.speaker: Gloria Tory
326.text: "You have seen the recession. It's proven that this experiment doesn't work. But anyway..."

327.speaker: Gloria Tory
327.text: "We have to calculate every possibility, Mr. President. After all, I do not see eye to eye with your other policies."

328.speaker: Gloria Tory
328.text: "Especially your promotion of eastern values. Getting closer to United Contana will definitely create huge problems for us."

329.speaker: Gloria Tory
329.text: "I hope you are not going to follow through with that idea to the end. Flirting with the Malenyevists will only bring us trouble."

330.speaker: Gloria Tory
330.text: "We have to calculate every possibility, Mr. President. After all, this is Sordland."

337.speaker: Gloria Tory
337.text: "I just hope you won't continue Alphonso's destruction of the country with your economic policies."

338.speaker: Gloria Tory
338.text: "I just hope you won't flirt with the Malenyevists. Your promotion of eastern values was troubling."

339.speaker: Gloria Tory
339.text: "Of course, I can't guarantee that all the conservatives of the party will vote for your constitutional changes."

340.speaker: Gloria Tory
340.text: "That will depend to some extent on your policies. But the signatures, at least, are as good as gathered."

341.speaker: Player
341.text: "Signatures are not enough. We'll need all the votes from the USP."

348.speaker: Gloria Tory
348.text: "I am completely against your efforts to privatize our educational institutions."

352.speaker: Gloria Tory
352.text: "The State must be responsible for educating its citizens. Your reform will corrupt our education system and bring foreign influence..."

353.speaker: Gloria Tory
353.text: "I am concerned about the Oligarchs and the state of our economy. I am worried that they may influence you for their own benefit."

354.speaker: Gloria Tory
354.text: "But we'll discuss that later. What we expect from you is not to pursue further privatization. If you start privatizing health care or state-owned corporations, I doubt I can help you."

355.speaker: Gloria Tory
355.text: "We expect you to succeed where Alphonso failed in resisting their siren call. If you start privatizing health care or state-owned corporations, I doubt I can help you."

356.speaker: Gloria Tory
356.text: "Before we finish...There is one thing I need to say."

357.speaker: Gloria Tory
357.text: "Before we finish... There is one thing I need to say."

359.speaker: Player
359.text: "I can't promise anything. These decisions depend on the circumstances."

361.speaker: Player
361.text: "It will happen one way or another."

362.speaker: Gloria Tory
362.text: "For the sake of your reforms, you'd better hope that it doesn't."

363.speaker: Gloria Tory
363.text: "I know. That's why I want to see you succeed."

369.speaker: Gloria Tory
369.text: "I believe I can give you the help you require."

372.speaker: Gloria Tory
372.text: "I believe I've made myself clear. Thanks for stopping by, Mr. President. I hope you'll hold your promises."

373.speaker: Narrator
373.text: She extended her hand to me for a handshake.

374.speaker: Narrator
374.text: Once I shook her hand, she immediately sat back down.

375.speaker: Gloria Tory
375.text: "But now I need to get back to my duties. If you'll excuse me, Mr. President."

377.speaker: Player
377.text: "I'll be expecting your wing's support, Mrs. Tory."

378.speaker: Player
378.text: "I understand. I'll leave you to it."

380.speaker: Narrator
380.text: She only responded with a nod as I left her office.

382.speaker: Gloria Tory
382.text: "I must get back to work. Thanks for stopping by, Mr. President."

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: She extended her hand to me for a handshake.

385.speaker: Player_Italic
385.text: Walk away without shaking her hand.

387.speaker: Player
387.text: "I'm not going anywhere until you give me the signatures."

388.speaker: Gloria Tory
388.text: "Please do not humiliate yourself further, Mr. President."

390.speaker: Gloria Tory
390.text: "This doesn't mean we won't be able to cooperate on other matters. I hope to speak again soon."

396.speaker: Gloria Tory
396.text: "I don't see why the backbone of this party should support your rushed reforms."

397.speaker: Player
397.text: "You will give me the signatures. I don't care if it's willingly or not."

398.speaker: Player
398.text: "Don't forget who you are talking to."

401.speaker: Narrator
401.text: Albin and the reformist wing was my last hope to get the needed 150 signatures for the proposal.

402.speaker: Narrator
402.text: Even then, it looked quite uncertain if we could get 166 votes in the Assembly.

403.speaker: Narrator
403.text: I went outside. Serge drove me back to the palace, where I met Lucian and told him the bad news.

405.speaker: Gloria Tory
405.text: "My conscience doesn't allow me to help the spread of Malenyevism."

408.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
408.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false

409.speaker: Gloria Tory
409.text: "Then there will be no further discussion."
409.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false)

410.speaker: Player
410.text: "I can't give you what you want, Mrs. Tory."

412.speaker: Gloria Tory
412.text: "Too bad. I thought we were close to an arrangement."

417.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
417.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Impeachment_Default"] == false)  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false)

418.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
418.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Impeachment_Default"] == false)  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false)) == false

419.speaker: Gloria Tory
419.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Impeachment_Default"] == false)  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false)

421.speaker: Gloria Tory
421.text: "I can't support you giving yourself absolute immunity while taking the Court's away. This is unacceptable."

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: She repositioned herself on the chair.

427.speaker: Gloria Tory
427.text: "I don't see any real reform here, Mr. President. Do you?"
427.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Default"] == false) == false)

428.speaker: Player
428.text: "It seems our understanding of reform is very different."

433.speaker: Narrator
433.text: She took a look at the proposal.
433.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == true) == false)

434.speaker: Narrator
434.text: The conservative side was handled, but to get to the 150 signatures I needed, I would still have to deal with Albin Clavin and the reformist wing.

435.speaker: Narrator
435.text: I went outside. Serge drove me back to the palace, where I met Lucian and told him about the progress I'd made with Gloria.

442.speaker: Gloria Tory
442.text: "So. How does the presidential chair compare to the ones in the Assembly?"

454.speaker: Gloria Tory
454.text: "A President that has the power to impeach Justices will be very dangerous in the future. We shouldn't damage the separation of powers."

456.speaker: Gloria Tory
456.text: "Increasing the threshold to 15 percent ought to mollify a lot of lifetime USP members. It secures our advantageous position and further consolidates it by leaving other parties out."

492.speaker: Gloria Tory
492.text: "The conservatives will be expecting a lot from you."

493.speaker: Player
493.text: "I will be expecting a lot from conservatives as well."

506.speaker: Player
506.text: "No, this is too important to me. But what if I remove the change to the threshold instead?" [CHANGE THE REFORM]

510.speaker: Player
510.text: "No. We could talk about the other clauses instead."

514.speaker: Player
514.text: "You win. How about I remove the change to the threshold instead?" [CHANGE THE REFORM]

519.speaker: Gloria Tory
519.text: "I do have one condition. I want you to cancel that speech you were planning for your wife at the Benfi Festival."

520.speaker: Gloria Tory
520.text: "Mayor Leste is not only popular in Benfi, he's one of the most influential members of the USP's conservative wing."

521.speaker: Gloria Tory
521.text: "We wouldn't want to upset him, would we?"

522.speaker: Player
522.text: "What does he have to do with anything?"

525.speaker: Player
525.text: "Fine. I'll have Monica taken off the schedule and let him speak."

526.speaker: Gloria Tory
526.text: "He's not the only person who would be upset, Mr. President. You know that."

527.speaker: Gloria Tory
527.text: "If you want conservative support, you cannot let the First Lady speak in Mr. Leste's stead."

532.speaker: Player
532.text: "No. I won't let my wife down like that."

533.speaker: Gloria Tory
533.text: "Tell me, why does she want to do this speech so badly?"

534.speaker: Player
534.text: "She wants to give Sordish women a voice."

535.speaker: Gloria Tory
535.text: "So do I. But this is not the way."

536.speaker: Player
536.text: "This isn't about her, it's about women's rights. I thought you'd understand."

537.speaker: Gloria Tory
537.text: "Believe me, I understand. More than your wife, even."

538.speaker: Gloria Tory
538.text: "I've spent nearly two decades in this Assembly. I know how real change happens."

539.speaker: Gloria Tory
539.text: "The old conservative men who hold the power in this government will not listen to Mrs. Rayne's speech and suddenly have a change of heart. Rather the opposite."

540.speaker: Player
540.text: "All right. I'll tell Monica the speech is off."

541.speaker: Player
541.text: "She wants First Lady to be more than just a ceremonial position."

542.speaker: Gloria Tory
542.text: "And why should it be? What does your wife know about politics?"

543.speaker: Player
543.text: "Does it matter? She's my wife. If it's important to her, it's important to me."

544.speaker: Gloria Tory
544.text: "As important as the change you claim to be fighting for?"

545.speaker: Gloria Tory
545.text: "They'll see a shrill, hectoring housewife who slept with the President for a spot on that stage and is now hopelessly out of her depth."

546.speaker: Player
546.text: "That's unfair. Monica's been campaigning for women's rights since I met her."

548.speaker: Gloria Tory
548.text: "I'm just telling you what others will think."

549.speaker: Gloria Tory
549.text: "Listen, I do believe the status of women could improve during your administration. Your education minister has been gathering ideas for a bill that appears quite promising."

550.speaker: Gloria Tory
550.text: "But you've got to have patience. Having Monica speak now will be detrimental for all of us."

551.speaker: Gloria Tory
551.text: "Just let Mayor Leste have his little moment in the spotlight. His time will be over soon enough."

552.speaker: Player
552.text: "No. Monica will speak at the festival."

553.speaker: Gloria Tory
553.text: "Thank you. Trust me, it's for the best."

554.speaker: Player
554.text: "You sound bitter. I'm sorry your path to the top wasn't as easy as hers."

555.speaker: Gloria Tory
555.text: "It wasn't. But that has nothing to do with it."

558.speaker: Gloria Tory
558.text: "I have serious reservations about privatizing healthcare or the Sordish State Corporation. The support of my faction can change."
